definition: Pheme is a 36-month research project begun in 2014 into establishing the veracity of claims made on the internet..

story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Pheme (project).
